provenance.name: water_stream

Strictly 2D painterly ink-and-earth brushwork, subtle broad reflections and tiny calm surface variation, low contrast. Tile uniformly fills entire frame; no shore, no rocks, no horizon, no identifiable reflected trees, no foam, no white streaks or motion, no text. Seamless all four edges; no cast shadows. provenance.name: water_fall

Tall narrow portrait 1:4 aspect ratio, front-on white waterfall curtain with crisp multi-tier vertical streaks and restrained soft foam at bottom; 3 metres wide, 12 metres tall. Flat painted ink-and-earth style, fine brushwork, soft ivory upper-left golden highlights, cool white shaded streaks. Genuine transparent background, no glow or fog halo, no rocks, no landscape, no pool, no text, no watermark. Water fills central 80% width, fades toward transparent side edges, starts at top and cascades to bottom. Clean separate game texture asset only.

Ellipse width to height 1:0.6, centred on canvas, foam band between radii 0.35 and 0.48 of canvas width; no foam within inner hole. provenance.name: backdrop_peaks_far
provenance.prompt: Wide horizontal single distant Chinese mountain horizon layer for a 2D painted wuxia game. Very pale misty olive-gray natural mountain peak silhouettes, quiet refined ink-wash and earth painterly brushwork, harmonious golden afternoon light. Isolated mountains on genuine transparent background, no sky painted, no ground foreground, no trees, no buildings, no text. Panorama 4:1 aspect ratio, peaks span edge to edge with several varied gentle sharp summits, tallest summit at 15% from top, low valleys at 45% from top, top 10% completely empty; mountain bases softly fade into transparency at bottom 15%. Horizontal repeat seamlessly, same height and color of ridge at left and right edges. Far atmospheric low contrast distant layer; no dramatic crags.

provenance.name: backdrop_peaks_near
provenance.prompt: Single wide panoramic near mountain horizon layer for strictly 2D classical Chinese wuxia painted game. Muted misty olive-gray natural mountain peak silhouettes, hand-painted ink-and-earth brushwork, quiet golden afternoon illumination from upper left. Slightly darker nearer mountain layer, still low contrast atmospheric. Transparent background: NO painted sky. Mountains across full width, a chain of 5 to 7 irregular graceful summits at heights 55 to 85 percent from bottom. Wide 4:1 panorama. Top 10 percent completely empty alpha; mountain base fades into golden haze and full transparency at bottom 15%. Seamlessly repeating left-right with matching ridge height at both edges. No buildings, no characters, no distinct foreground trees, no text, no watermark. No harsh black outlines.

limitations: Unity importer, shader composition, mipmapped edge behavior, and in-game camera acceptance require engine integration.
Peak source images are 2172x724 and resampled to required 4096x1024 delivery canvases.
processing: Water stream and shore opposite edge bands blended to periodic boundaries, preserving painted interior.
Shore opacity derived from generated painted luminance multiplied by original alpha.
Waterfall 10 percent side fades; foam elliptical alpha mask with soft inner and outer fades.
Peak skyline reframed at y154, premultiplied-alpha horizontal seam blend, bottom 15 percent alpha fade. Far source prematurely empty base cropped to last median-alpha128 row before reframing.
